name: regex_anchored_line_start
description: The sprint-counting regex uses `^` anchor with the multiline flag (`m`) so that only headings starting at column 1 are matched, not inline prose references to sprints.

name: inline_sprint_references_not_counted
description: A spec containing '## Sprint 1' and '## Sprint 2' as line-start headings plus prose like 'builds on Sprint 3 features' or blockquoted '> ## Sprint 4' yields a total sprint count of 2.

name: standard_multiline_spec_counted_correctly
description: A spec with four '## Sprint N' headings each at column 1 on their own line yields a total sprint count of 4.

name: log_filename_timestamp_format
description: All conversation log filenames are prefixed with a timestamp matching the pattern YYYY.MM.DD-HH.MM.SS- (e.g., '2026.04.12-14.30.00-sprint-2-attempt-0-generator.md').

name: resume_does_not_overwrite_logs
description: When the harness resumes and re-runs the same sprint/attempt, a new log file is created with a different timestamp prefix; the original log file from the prior run remains on disk and is not overwritten or deleted.

name: contract_negotiation_logs_timestamped
description: Contract negotiation conversation logs follow the timestamped naming pattern (e.g., 'YYYY.MM.DD-HH.MM.SS-sprint-3-contract-negotiation.md').

name: all_agent_log_types_timestamped
description: Generator, Evaluator, Planner, and Documenter conversation logs all use the timestamp prefix format — no log file in .adhd/logs/ is written without a timestamp prefix.

name: timestamp_uses_configured_timezone
description: The timestamp in log filenames reflects the configured timezone (not UTC by default unless configured as UTC), consistent with the HH:MM:SS timestamps used in terminal output.

name: langfuse_span_names_aligned
description: Langfuse trace span names for agent conversations include the same timestamped identifier used in the log filename, enabling cross-referencing between log files and trace spans.

name: regex_fix_has_test_coverage
description: There is at least one test file covering the sprint-counting regex that tests: (1) standard headings are counted, (2) inline prose references are not counted, and (3) blockquoted or indented heading-like lines are not counted.

name: existing_contract_reused_on_resume
description: When the harness runs with --resume and `.adhd/contracts/sprint-N.json` already exists on disk, it loads and uses that contract without invoking contract negotiation agents (no Planner/Evaluator calls for that sprint's contract).

name: missing_contract_triggers_negotiation
description: When the harness runs with --resume and `.adhd/contracts/sprint-N.json` does NOT exist on disk, contract negotiation proceeds normally as if it were a fresh run.

name: loaded_contract_logged
description: When an existing contract is loaded from disk during resume, a log message is emitted that includes both the fact it was loaded from disk and the number of criteria in the contract (e.g., 'Loaded contract from disk for sprint 2 with 8 criteria').

name: contract_file_validation
description: When loading a contract from disk, the code validates that the file contains well-formed JSON matching the expected contract structure before using it. Malformed or empty contract files trigger negotiation rather than crashing.

name: parse_failure_writes_diagnostic_file
description: When parseContract fails to extract valid JSON from the evaluator's contract review response, a file `.adhd/logs/sprint-N-contract-parse-error.txt` is created containing the full raw unparseable text.

name: parse_failure_logs_truncated_preview
description: When parseContract falls back to the default contract due to a parse failure, a warning is logged to the console containing a truncated preview of the raw text (not the full 2000+ character blob).

name: successful_parse_no_diagnostic_file
description: When parseContract successfully extracts valid contract JSON, no `.adhd/logs/sprint-N-contract-parse-error.txt` file is created.

name: diagnostic_directory_created_on_demand
description: If `.adhd/logs/` does not exist when a parse error diagnostic needs to be written, the directory is created automatically (no crash on missing directory).

name: truncation_length_reasonable
description: The truncated preview logged to console on parse failure is capped at a reasonable length (200-500 characters) with an ellipsis or indicator showing it was truncated, so console output stays readable.

name: adhd_artifacts_committed_before_generator
description: Before each Generator agent invocation, all pending .adhd/ files (contracts, progress, feedback) are staged and committed with a commit message prefixed by '[adhd]'. The Generator starts with no uncommitted .adhd/ files in the working tree.

name: adhd_commit_message_format
description: The commit created for .adhd/ artifacts uses a message starting with '[adhd]' and includes the sprint number (e.g., '[adhd] Sprint 2: artifacts').

name: clean_working_tree_for_generator
description: After .adhd/ artifacts are committed and before the Generator session begins, running 'git status --porcelain' on .adhd/ paths returns no output, confirming a clean working tree.

name: revert_uses_git_reset_hard
description: The revertToCheckpoint function uses 'git reset --hard <sha>' instead of 'git revert --no-commit'. No calls to 'git revert' remain in the revert/rollback code path.

name: adhd_files_survive_revert
description: When revertToCheckpoint resets to a checkpoint SHA, .adhd/ files (progress.json, contracts/, feedback/) that were written after the checkpoint are preserved by stashing before reset and unstashing after. The files exist on disk with their pre-revert contents after the operation completes.

name: stash_unstash_error_handling
description: If git stash or unstash fails during revertToCheckpoint, the error is logged with a meaningful message and does not cause an unhandled exception. The revert still completes (reset --hard succeeds) even if stash restoration fails.

name: documenting_status_type
description: The HarnessProgress type's status union includes 'documenting' as a valid value alongside existing values like 'running', 'complete', etc. TypeScript compilation succeeds with this addition.

name: documenting_status_set_before_documenter
description: Before the Documenter agent is invoked, progress.json is written with status set to 'documenting'. This occurs after all sprints pass and before the Documenter starts its work.

name: complete_status_after_documenter
description: After the Documenter agent finishes (or is skipped), progress.json is updated to status 'complete'. The 'documenting' status is a transient state visible only while documentation is in progress.

name: no_regression_on_existing_revert_callers
description: All existing call sites that invoke revertToCheckpoint continue to work correctly with the new reset-based implementation. Resume flows that trigger checkpoint revert do not fail or leave the repo in a broken state.

name: commit_is_noop_when_no_changes
description: If there are no pending .adhd/ changes when the pre-Generator commit step runs (e.g., files were already committed), no empty commit is created. The harness handles the nothing-to-commit case gracefully.
